title: Where can you fly direct from Liverpool Airport?
author: Matt
intro: Liverpool John Lennon has direct flights with easyJet, Ryanair and Jet2 to city breaks, sun spots and, this winter, Iceland and Lapland. Here's where you can go, and what's new for winter 2026.
seo_title: Liverpool Airport direct flights: 2026 route guide
seo_description: easyJet, Ryanair and Jet2 fly from Liverpool to Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland and more, and new winter routes to Reykjavik, Lapland and Copenhagen.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Airlines:** easyJet, Ryanair, Jet2
- **Ryanair this winter:** 27 routes
- **New for winter:** Reykjavik, Lapland
- **Longest flights:** about 4 to 5 hours

Liverpool is mainly a short-haul airport: almost everything is in Europe, North Africa or the Canary Islands. We checked these routes in October 2026 from airline announcements and the airport's news. Routes change every season, so always check the airline's own timetable before you plan a trip around one.

sections.heading: Who flies from Liverpool
sections.text:
Three airlines carry most of Liverpool's holiday traffic, and they do quite different jobs.

| Airline | Best for | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| easyJet | City breaks and sun, all year | Lisbon, Seville, Naples, Malta |
| Ryanair | Cheap city breaks, Poland and the Baltics | Porto, Krakow, Copenhagen, Bergamo |
| Jet2 | Package holidays and summer sun | Spain, the Canaries, Greece, Turkey |

easyJet has the biggest base, with nine aircraft based at Liverpool since August 2026. Ryanair added a sixth based aircraft for winter 2026 and says it will fly 27 routes from Liverpool this winter. Jet2 sells flights and package holidays to around 23 summer destinations from Liverpool, mostly beach resorts.

sections.heading: City breaks
sections.text:
Liverpool is a good airport for short city breaks, with lots of routes of around two to three hours:

- **Portugal:** [Porto](/destinations/porto) with Ryanair and [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon) with easyJet.
- **Spain:** [Seville](/destinations/seville), new with easyJet in August 2026.
- **Italy:** [Naples](/destinations/naples) with easyJet, and Milan Bergamo, handy for [Lake Como](/destinations/lake-como), with Ryanair.
- **Central Europe:** [Krakow](/destinations/krakow), [Gdansk](/destinations/gdansk) and Warsaw with Ryanair, and [Prague](/destinations/prague) and [Berlin](/destinations/berlin) with easyJet.
- **Scandinavia:** [Copenhagen](/destinations/copenhagen), new with Ryanair this winter.

Ryanair says Bergamo, Copenhagen, Gdansk, Porto, Tirana and Warsaw are new or extended for winter 2026, so they're useful for a pre-Christmas break.

sections.heading: New this winter: Iceland and Lapland
sections.text:
easyJet is adding two winter routes from Liverpool that used to mean a trip to Manchester:

| Route | Starts | How often |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Reykjavik](/destinations/reykjavik) | 2 November 2026 | Twice a week |
| Kittilä, for [Levi](/destinations/levi) | 25 November 2026 | Twice a week |

Kittilä is the airport for Levi, one of Finnish Lapland's biggest resorts, so this makes a December trip to see snow, huskies and maybe the northern lights possible without driving to another airport.

Tip: with only two flights a week to Kittilä, your trip length is set by the flight days. Pick those first, then book your accommodation around them.

sections.heading: Sun and beach holidays
sections.image_alt: A passenger jet parked on the apron with boarding stairs at its front door under a clear blue sky
sections.image_caption: Most of Liverpool's flights are short hops of two to four hours.
sections.text:
For a week in the sun, you have a choice of a cheap flight with easyJet or Ryanair, or a package with Jet2.

- **Spain and the islands:** Alicante and Palma have been easyJet staples from Liverpool for years, and Jet2 flies to mainland Spain, the Balearics and the Canaries.
- **Canary Islands:** [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura) with easyJet is one of the warmest winter options.
- **Further east:** [Malta](/destinations/malta) with easyJet and [Split](/destinations/split) for Croatia, plus [Paphos](/destinations/paphos) for Cyprus.
- **North Africa:** [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) with easyJet, for winter sun only a little over three hours away.

Jet2's Liverpool programme also includes Greece, Turkey, Portugal and Madeira. Its exact list changes from year to year, so check which resorts are on sale from Liverpool for your dates.

sections.heading: Getting the most from a smaller airport
sections.text:
Liverpool is much quieter than Manchester, which is the main reason to use it. Security queues are usually shorter, the walk to the gate is short, and parking is often cheaper.

Watch out: many routes only fly two to four times a week, so you may not be able to do an exact three-night trip, and a cancelled flight can mean a long wait for the next one.

Our guide to [how early to arrive at Liverpool Airport](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-liverpool-airport) has the timings, transport links and busy times.

If the route you want isn't on, compare it with [Manchester](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-manchester-airport), which has far more long-haul and more daily departures.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Liverpool?
sections.text:
With so many short routes, Liverpool is great for a long weekend:

- **City breaks:** [Porto](/destinations/porto), [Krakow](/destinations/krakow) and [Seville](/destinations/seville)
- **Winter sun:** [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura) or [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech)
- **Snow:** [Levi](/destinations/levi), via Kittilä

The [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) and [Christmas holidays](/destinations/christmas-holidays) pages have more ideas. If your family can't agree, read our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday), or add everyone's picks to somewhere.party and let the draw choose.

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from Liverpool John Lennon Airport?
faqs.answer: easyJet, Ryanair and Jet2 carry most passengers, with easyJet the biggest.

faqs.question: Can you fly to Lapland from Liverpool?
faqs.answer: Yes. From 25 November 2026, easyJet flies twice a week from Liverpool to Kittilä, the airport for Levi in Finnish Lapland.

faqs.question: Can you fly from Liverpool to Iceland?
faqs.answer: Yes. easyJet starts flights from Liverpool to Reykjavik on 2 November 2026, twice a week on Mondays and Fridays.

faqs.question: Are there long-haul flights from Liverpool Airport?
faqs.answer: No. Liverpool's flights are short and medium-haul, to Europe, North Africa and the Canary Islands. For long-haul, the nearest big airport is Manchester.
